extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: city bus (low-floor, single deck), approx. 12.4 x 2.5 x 3.2 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.96 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; three double doors on the right side are modelled closed (fixed); the destination display is a neutral glowing panel without text; 4 wheel objects (rear with dual tires) are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll), the front wheels also steer around local Z; opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
